text.title: Learning Speed as Competitive Moat Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: inputs → procedure steps → final artefact matching the JSON Schema in 02-output-contract.xml. Then: prompt patterns with XML structure for the belief-updater and strategy-reviewer agents.

section.title: Inputs (mocked)
section.note: Pulled per `## Prerequisites`; sources cited in `01-core-rules.xml` rationale.

section.title: Step-by-step application
section.note: 1. Preconditions check: all `## Applies If` items satisfied; no `## Skip If` items fired.
2. Inputs gathered from named sources; freshness OK.
4. Artefact produced from `templates/` rendered with real values (see Final Artefact below).

section.title: Prompt patterns

example.title: Belief-updater (XML structured output)
example.code: <role>belief-updater</role> <current_beliefs>{{ beliefs_yaml }}</current_beliefs> <new_events>{{ events_jsonl }}</new_events> <rules> Only mutate a belief if (a) >=3 independent event_ids agree, OR (b) 1 high-severity event directly contradicts current claim with cited URL/transcript. Never invent beliefs. Cite event_id for every change. </rules> <output_schema> {changed:[{belief_id, before, after, evidence:[event_id], confidence_delta}], unchanged_with_pressure:[{belief_id, opposing_evidence:[event_id]}]} </output_schema>

example.title: Strategy-reviewer (opus, neutral framing)
example.code: <role>strategy-reviewer</role> <beliefs>{{ beliefs_yaml }}</beliefs> <roadmap>{{ roadmap_md }}</roadmap> <experiments>{{ experiments_yaml }}</experiments> <deliverable>For each roadmap item: keep|kill|reframe, cited evidence, decision_owner, check_back_date.</deliverable> <constraint>Default to "kill" if evidence_for_keeping < 3 cited events in last 30 days. Never reuse last week's recommendation without re-citing.</constraint>

section.reference: Weekly belief-update loop: loads events.ndjson, calls Claude, writes beliefs.yaml
